title_en: Super apartment 2+1+2 verandas for sale in Shkoza, near News 24 (for sale also with credit)
description_en: Description APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 VERANDA Apartment 2+1 + 2 verandas for sale in Shkoza area, in front of News24 Rr. Alexander Martel. The apartment is fully furnished, 130m2 net and consists of 1 living room - kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 1 toilet, 1 spacious hallway, 2 large verandas. It is located on the 2nd technical floor and the 1st residential floor. The area offers all facilities: public transport, supermarket, pharmacy, bars-restaurants, etc. 🚙 In the area there is a parking space available for the residents of the neighborhood 🚙 Possibility of purchase with credit
